record_title: Exponentially sharp logarithmic asymptotics for totative dominance thresholds
provenance: Asymptotic analysis of the exact totative-dominance threshold sequences introduced by Amirali Fatehizadeh in arXiv:2609.13852v1, combining primorial extremality with classical prime-number and Mertens-product estimates and Lambert-W inversion.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint is very recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. No inaccessible source with metadata specifically suggesting the same threshold asymptotics was identified. The result is asymptotic in k, does not prove M_k=N_{k+1}, does not assert that exact last failures are always primorials, and does not optimize the zero-free-region constant in the exponential error. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
